“不是说下午把夹座还回去？”

塔维摇头。

pairs.english: He didn't need it; he'd succeeded again that morning and felt they ought to keep doing something that afternoon.

pairs.english: Instructor Vey had watched two days earlier; today, on a different table, he could still switch the bells.

pairs.english: Both attempts were brief, his fingers fine afterward. He wanted to tell her, but Mira had been there.

pairs.english: Suyi set the roll on her knees and asked Mira whether her submitted channel drawing had been returned.

pairs.english: “Better than standing outside,” Suyi said.

pairs.english: Only then did Tavi understand: the south building's senior roof-framing class had a few observer places that afternoon.

pairs.english: “Why didn't you say?” She bit a hard grain of rice, paused, and spat it onto the bowl's edge.
pairs.hanzi:
“你怎么没说？”
她咬到一颗硬米，停下来，把它吐到碗边。

pairs.target: " méi dìng de shì . nǐ yě xiǎng qù ? "
pairs.english: “It wasn't settled. Did you want to go too?”
pairs.hanzi: “没定的事。你也想去？”

pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见她往苏苡那边瞥了一眼，心里那点不舒服一下变得具体了：

pairs.hanzi:
“没事。”
米拉的筷子停住。
“你别这样说。你到底想不想去？”

pairs.hanzi: “装置是一起做的。”她说，“下午这个，我一直想去。”

pairs.hanzi:

“我的位置呢？”

pairs.english: Tavi shifted inward. Iven squeezed in with his knee against a table leg and asked why everyone looked as though they'd eaten stones.

pairs.english: Suyi laughed aloud; Mira lowered her head and laughed too. Tavi wasn't laughing yet, but could finally swallow his soup.

pairs.english: “Can you show me when you're back? The one without posts.” “If they let me bring the drawing.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你回来能给我看看吗？那个不用柱子的。”
“要是让我带图出来。”

pairs.english: “If not, use chopsticks.” She glanced at him and put them in their cloth sleeve. “Then we'll need two more pairs.”
pairs.hanzi:
“带不出来就摆筷子。”
她看了他一眼，把筷子收进布套。
“那得多找两双。”

pairs.target: tā zǒu hòu , yīwén wèn tǎ wéi xiàwǔ zuò shénme . tǎ wéi shuō hái bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: After she left, Iven asked Tavi's plans for the afternoon. He didn't know yet.
pairs.hanzi: 她走后，伊文问塔维下午做什么。塔维说还不知道。

pairs.target: yīwén lìkè shuō yǒu jiàn hěn róngyì de shì , qù jiù jiǎngtáng bāngmáng zhàn yíhuìer jiù xíng .
pairs.english: Iven immediately proposed something easy: stand a while in the old lecture hall to help.

pairs.hanzi: 到了那里，塔维才知道，“站一会儿”是替缺人的低声部唱一段。

pairs.english: Iven had joined the evening choir and rehearsed twice, still missing his entrance, and wanted company.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文报名参加晚间合唱，排了两次，始终找不准进声的位置，想拉个人陪他。

pairs.english: The senior leading asked Tavi to try a line. He shook his head: he couldn't.
pairs.hanzi: 领唱的高年级学生让塔维试一句。他摇头，说自己不会。

pairs.target: nà rén méi quàn , zhī zhǐxiàng qiángbiān de mùxiāng : " nà nǐ bāng wǒ dǎpāizi . děng wǒ diǎntóu zài qiāo . "
pairs.english: The student didn't press him, just pointed at a wooden box by the wall. “Keep time for me, then. Wait for my nod.”
pairs.hanzi: 那人没劝，只指向墙边的木箱：“那你帮我打拍子。等我点头再敲。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò dào xiāng páng , kànzhe yìpái rén xīqì , xiōngkǒu gēnzhe jǐn le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi sat by the box, his own chest tightening as he watched a row of people breathe in.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐到箱旁，看着一排人吸气，胸口跟着紧了一下。

pairs.target: dìyīshēng chūlái shí , yīwén qiǎng zǎo le , lìngwài jǐgè rén yě bèi tā dài wāi .
pairs.english: At the first note Iven came in early, taking several others with him.
pairs.hanzi: 第一声出来时，伊文抢早了，另外几个人也被他带歪。

pairs.target: lǐngchàng bìshàngyǎn , bàntiān cái zhēngkāi . " yīwén . nǐ néng bunéng xiān ràng biérén bǎ qì xīwán ? "
pairs.english: The leader closed his eyes for a long moment. “Iven. Could you let everyone finish breathing first?”
pairs.hanzi:
领唱闭上眼，半天才睁开。
“伊文。你能不能先让别人把气吸完？”

alignment.english: closed his eyes for a long moment

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu rěn xiào , yīwén zhǐ le zhǐ tā , xiàng yào bǎ xiàoshēng jì zài zhàng shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down, suppressing laughter; Iven pointed at him as if adding it to an account.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头忍笑，伊文指了指他，像要把笑声记在账上。

pairs.target: zài lái yícì , tǎ wéi děngdào diǎntóu cái luò shǒu .
pairs.english: On the next try, Tavi waited for the nod before striking.
pairs.hanzi: 再来一次，塔维等到点头才落手。

pairs.target: mùxiāng fāchū chénchénde yìshēng , suíhòu jǐtiáo bùtóng de shēngyīn hézàiyìqǐ , cóng tā zuò zhe de dìfāng wǎng wūdǐng shēng .
pairs.english: The box gave a deep note; different voices joined and rose from where he sat toward the roof.
pairs.hanzi: 木箱发出沉沉的一声，随后几条不同的声音合在一起，从他坐着的地方往屋顶升。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiārù , zhī ànzhe pāizi qiāo , què búzài juéde zìjǐ shì bèi shuí shèngxià de .
pairs.english: He didn't sing, only kept the beat, yet no longer felt left behind.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有加入，只按着拍子敲，却不再觉得自己是被谁剩下的。

pairs.target: sàn de shíhòu , yīwén sǎngzi yǎ le yìdiǎn , shuō xiàcì hái quē rén .
pairs.english: Afterward Iven was a little hoarse and said they'd need people next time too.
pairs.hanzi: 散的时候，伊文嗓子哑了一点，说下次还缺人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ mùxiāng tuīhuí qiángbiān . " xiàcì nǐ dé xiān gàosù wǒ , shì chànggē . "
pairs.english: Tavi pushed the box back to the wall. “Next time tell me first that it's singing.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维把木箱推回墙边。
“下次你得先告诉我，是唱歌。”
